title: Solution and complete regression
objective: Verify project loading, builds, ABI checks and all automated verdicts.
preconditions: Visual Studio 18 Insiders / v145. No physical equipment is required.
steps: Open source\ARTestCLI.sln in Visual Studio. Select x64 and Debug.
All 10 projects load, including ARTestSdkExample; no duplicate-item errors.
Run .\scripts\build.ps1 -Configuration Debug -Platform x64.
Architecture and ABI checks pass. Google Test: 139 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
Run .\scripts\build.ps1 -Configuration Release -Platform x64.
The same 139 tests pass; XML/HTML consistency validation passes.
Open artifacts\test-results\x64\Debug\ARTestCLI.UnitTests.html and the corresponding Release report.
Both show PASSED, Total=139, Passed=139, Failed=0. Record both screenshots.

title: Inspect the author-facing API
objective: Confirm the example exposes component behavior without handwritten binary plumbing.
preconditions: The SDK example project is visible in Solution Explorer.
steps: Open ReadVoltageCommand.h and SimulatedSupplyDriver.h in ARTestSdkExample.
Command implements Validate/Execute; driver implements Initialize/Shutdown and registers one operation.
Open ExampleExtension.cpp.
It declares AddCommand/AddDriver and one ARTEST_EXPORT_EXTENSION. No ABI function table or handle cast is handwritten.
Open source\ARTest.SDK\README.md and docs\sdk\ai-extension-authoring.md.
Public entry points, lifetimes, error propagation, testing and agent constraints are documented. Record evidence and any ambiguity.

title: Compile and execute the SDK example
objective: Verify the new C++ adapter integrates with the existing Engine.
preconditions: Define $cli, $extensions and $sample as shown on the environment page.
steps: Run & $cli compile $sample --extensions $extensions; $LASTEXITCODE.
Valid script. No instruments were initialized. Exit 0; no initialization events.
Run & $cli run $sample --extensions $extensions; $LASTEXITCODE.
Driver initializes, step reports Measured 12.000000 V., driver shuts down, final PASSED; exit 0.
Inspect artifacts\sdk-examples\x64\Release\ARTestSdkExample.
Contains ARTestSdkExample.dll, artest-extension.json and schemas. The normal extensions directory still contains four packages.

title: Reject invalid parameters and configuration
objective: Ensure schemas reject invalid input before execution and do not report success.
preconditions: Use the supplied fixtures; do not edit the example or packaged manifests.
steps: Run & $cli compile ".\quality\manual-tests\stage-d3.3a\data\invalid-channel.json" --extensions $extensions; $LASTEXITCODE.
PARAMETER_RANGE_INVALID identifies channel. Exit 3; no driver initialization.
Run & $cli run ".\quality\manual-tests\stage-d3.3a\data\invalid-config.json" --extensions $extensions; $LASTEXITCODE.
PARAMETER_RANGE_INVALID identifies voltage in configuration. Exit 3; no execution.
Run & $cli run $sample --extensions $extensions; $LASTEXITCODE.
The valid example still completes PASSED with exit 0. Earlier invalid attempts did not damage the package.

title: Cancel with guaranteed cleanup
objective: Verify cancellation of the SDK command still shuts down its driver.
preconditions: Release example and SDK catalog are built.
steps: Run & $cli debug $sample --extensions $extensions.
Driver initializes and the debugger pauses before step 1.
At the pause, enter q and press Enter. Then run $LASTEXITCODE.
CLEANING_UP and SDK simulated power supply shut down. are printed; final CANCELLED; exit 5.
Repeat with & $cli debug $sample --extensions $extensions, then enter c.
Execution completes PASSED, measurement is printed, cleanup occurs; exit 0.

title: SDK fault and ownership evidence
objective: Record direct evidence of ABI and fault cases that the CLI alone cannot expose.
preconditions: Full Release regression passed; its HTML report is available.
steps: Run .\scripts\test-sdk-authoring.ps1 -Configuration Release; $LASTEXITCODE.
All 41 selected SDK tests pass; exit 0. The full 139-test XML/HTML report is not overwritten.
In the full HTML report, search for SmallErrorBuffers and PartialInitializationCanCleanUp.
Both PASSED. Small buffers cannot truncate diagnostics or replay commands; partial initialization can clean up after cancellation.
Search for ReleaseFailuresCannotTurnIntoSuccess and MalformedOrRepeatedServiceResults.
Both PASSED. Failed release or invalid service output cannot become success.
Search for CommandBehaviorIsTestableWithoutEngineOrDll and ExampleDllRunsThroughTheUnmodifiedEngine.
Both PASSED, covering local behavior and real DLL integration. Attach evidence.

title: Configuration and fresh-run isolation
objective: Verify per-run driver configuration and state isolation.
preconditions: Use the voltage-5v fixture without editing binaries or source.
steps: Run & $cli run ".\quality\manual-tests\stage-d3.3a\data\voltage-5v.json" --extensions $extensions; $LASTEXITCODE.
Measured 5.000000 V.; final PASSED; exit 0.
Run & $cli run $sample --extensions $extensions; $LASTEXITCODE.
Measured 12.000000 V.; final PASSED; exit 0. The earlier configured voltage does not leak.
Complete actual results, evidence references and final acceptance fields.
All seven cases must be Passed before acceptance. Do not infer manual completion from the template.
